browser_route.note: Hand the user this link and stop. <RECORD_ID> is the 18-character Salesforce record id; it cannot be constructed from a planning reference, but PlanIt's applics `url` field is this deep link ready-made. With no record id to hand, give the register landing page instead: https://arcusbe.manchester.gov.uk/pr/s/register-view?c__r=Arcus_BE_Public_Register (there is no known URL parameter that pre-fills a search).

quirks.summary: No supported public API for register data: a plain HTTP client gets the Lightning app shell, never the search results, the detail record or the document list.
quirks.detail: Council-CNAME Salesforce Experience Cloud site (backing org manchestercitycouncil.lightning.force.com). The obstacle is architectural, not a challenge or a WAF - bot_protection is null for that reason, and it does not make an automated run any more feasible. There is no curl recipe for this vendor and none should be constructed.
quirks.workaround: Hand the user the browser_route deep link.

quirks.summary: PlanIt mislabels Manchester's scraper_type as 'Idox' - it is Arcus/Salesforce.
quirks.detail: Detect by the Salesforce markers instead: Server: sfdcedge, auraConfig, /sfsites/ paths. Trusting the label leads to running the Idox recipe against a portal that has no Idox endpoints at all.

source_notes:
Council-CNAME Experience Cloud site (backing org manchestercitycouncil.lightning.force.com). No supported public API for register data — browser-only. PlanIt mislabels scraper_type as 'Idox' — detect by Salesforce markers (Server: sfdcedge, auraConfig, /sfsites/). PlanIt url gives the record deep link /pr/s/detail/{recordId}. Hand users that link or the register-view URL.

Browser-only. Arcus registers have no anonymous API surface; defer to a real browser via the deep link.

verification.note: Plain HTTP returns the Salesforce Lightning app shell; no anonymous API surface for register data. No file retrieved.
